## Root Cause Analysis

The dominant root cause is colony-exec acting as a monolithic "god crate." It absorbed 8+ subsystems (file_tree, flux, goals, mirror, panes, sidebar, buffers, special_files) that have no relationship to POSIX fork/exec. This single architectural decision is the upstream cause of 10 of the 23 genuine issues: it forced inverted dependencies (agent imports exec types), created duplicate implementations (exec has its own goals/file_tree when dedicated crates exist), and pulled in UI dependencies (ratatui/crossterm) into the execution engine. The lib.rs bloat (4638 lines mixing EvalValue interpreter with Executor) is a direct consequence of this scope creep.

The second root cause is incomplete migrations. Four separate migration efforts stalled midway: file_tree (exec version 1051 lines vs colony-filetree 2023 lines), goals (exec version has Pending/InProgress vs colony-focus has Active), TUI renderers (legacy prompt_renderer.rs/sidebar_renderer.rs vs new prompt/renderer.rs and sidebar/renderer.rs), and CommandSub AST node (legacy pre-parsed vs new CommandSubRaw raw string). Each leaves two live code paths that diverge over time.

The third root cause is the absence of a shared persistence substrate. Six crates independently depend on rusqlite with their own db opening, schema management, and data directory resolution. This creates the conditions for mirror.rs to bypass the reflection API (since there is no standard way to query cross-crate).

## Recurring Dimensions

cross_module_architecture has 5 open issues -- the most of any dimension. This is not coincidence; the exec god-crate forces unnatural dependency directions. incomplete_migration has 4 open issues, all stemming from the pattern of creating new crates without removing the old code from exec. mid_level_elegance has 3 open issues, two of which (sidebar inline, agent dual paths) trace back to exec scope overload. low_level_elegance has 3 open issues though 1 is exaggerated (errexit). type_safety has 3 open issues from independent String-where-newtype-would-help patterns.

## Cluster Blueprint

### Cluster "exec-decomposition" (HIGH PRIORITY, LARGE)
Touches: crates/colony-exec/src/lib.rs, crates/colony-exec/src/flux/, crates/colony-exec/src/sidebar.rs, crates/colony-exec/src/mirror.rs, crates/colony-exec/Cargo.toml
Root issue: exec_scope_overload. 4 issues all trace to colony-exec absorbing non-execution concerns.
Strategy: Extract EvalValue and eval_* functions from lib.rs into eval.rs module (shrinks lib.rs from 4638 lines to ~3500). Extract flux/ TUI into colony-flux crate (removes ratatui/crossterm deps from exec). Move sidebar.rs to colony-panel. Move mirror.rs to colony-reflection or colony-mirror.
Must execute BEFORE incomplete-migrations cluster because removing exec's own file_tree/goals requires the decomposition mindset to be established.

### Cluster "incomplete-migrations" (HIGH PRIORITY, LARGE)
Touches: crates/colony-exec/src/file_tree/, crates/colony-exec/src/goals/, crates/colony-parser/src/ast.rs, crates/colony-tui/src/prompt_renderer.rs, crates/colony-tui/src/sidebar_renderer.rs, crates/colony-ui-core/src/builtins/sidebar_*.rs
5 issues all follow the same pattern: new implementation exists but old one was never removed.
Strategy: For each pair, pick the canonical version (colony-filetree over exec/file_tree, colony-focus over exec/goals, new TUI renderers over legacy, CommandSubRaw over CommandSub, sidebar/panels/ over builtins/sidebar_*), migrate callers, delete the old code.

4 issues about wrong dependency directions and duplicated persistence boilerplate.

Depends on: exec-decomposition (mirror.rs may move during decomposition; AgentDefinition lives in special_files which may also move).
